blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Patient-positioning errors can distort panoramic radiographs and lead to repeat examinations. This study investigated artificial intelligence for correcting these errors in existing images. A physics-based simulator generated paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from cone-beam computed tomography volumes, with controlled individual and combined positioning errors. Five approaches were compared: U-Net, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, an error-conditioned model, and a mixture of error-specific specialists. Evaluation used image similarity and geometric metrics across three test sets. All approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors, with U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperforming pix2pix and conditional diffusion.
blocks.zh: 患者定位出错会扭曲全景放射图,导致重复检查. 这项研究调查人工智能,以纠正现有图像中的这些错误. 一个基于物理的模拟器从圆锥束计算成的成像量中生成对位和错位的全景,并带有可控的单个和组合定位错误. 比较了五种方法:U-Net、pix2pix、有条件的传播、一个有错误条件的模型、一个有具体错误的专家的混合物。 评价采用三套测试的图像相似度和几何测量标准。 所有方法都改进了图像的相似性并减少了几何误差,U-Net和两个出错意识方法都比pix2pix和有条件的传播效果好.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Panoramic radiography provides an overview of the teeth, jaws,
and surrounding structures and is widely used in dental
assessment and treatment planning. However, incorrect patient
positioning can affect the appearance of anatomical structures
and limit diagnostic interpretation. Historical studies classified
33% and 24.9% of the panoramic radiographs examined as
diagnostically unacceptable. Images that require repeated
examination expose patients to additional, potentially avoidable
radiation [ 15 , 2 ] .

blocks.en:
Common positioning errors include placing
the patient too far forward or backward, raising or lowering
the chin, rotating or tilting the head, and failing to maintain
the tongue against the palate. These errors can cause blurring,
alter the apparent width of the anterior teeth and the appearance
of the occlusal plane, and produce asymmetry. Incorrect tongue
positioning creates a radiolucent band that can obscure the
maxillary tooth apices [ 2 , 12 ] .

blocks.en:
Artificial intelligence (AI) has been applied to the detection of
positioning errors and assessment of panoramic images [ 6 ] . Other studies have investigated generative
adversarial networks for restoring images affected by artificial
blur and noise [ 9 , 10 ] . These tasks differ
from correcting changes in projected anatomy caused by patient
positioning. More closely related work by Du et al. used a
convolutional neural network to estimate dental-arch positioning
errors and reconstruct panoramic images using corrected dental
curvature [ 4 ] . Further investigation is needed to assess
how different AI approaches perform when correcting individual
and combined positioning errors in panoramic images.

blocks.en: This study investigated whether AI could correct patient-positioning errors in existing panoramic radiographs, potentially reducing repeat examinations. To address the lack of suitable datasets, a physics-based simulator was developed to generate paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from CBCT volumes. These images were used to train and evaluate AI approaches for correcting individual and combined positioning errors.
blocks.zh: 这项研究调查了AI能否纠正现有全景放射图中的病人定位错误,有可能减少重复检查. 为了解决缺少合适的数据集的问题,开发了基于物理学的模拟器,从CBCT卷中生成对位和错位的全景. 这些图像被用于培训和评价人工智能方法,以纠正个人和综合定位错误。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Paired Data Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据生成

blocks.en: CBCT preparation and reference positioning. CBCT volumes were obtained from the MMDental dataset [ 19 ] , with voxel intensities treated as approximate Hounsfield units (HU). The jaws and teeth were segmented using DentalSegmentator [ 3 ] . The segmentations were used to estimate the occlusal and mid-sagittal planes for consistent head alignment. The head was then positioned using the anterior incisal midpoint as a reference, with the occlusal plane inclined 7 ∘ 7^{\circ} downward anteriorly. To establish the reference tongue position, oral-cavity air (HU < − 500 <-500 ) was replaced with soft tissue (40 HU).
blocks.zh: CBCT的准备和参考定位. CBCT卷取自MMDental数据集 [19] ,其中的活性强度作为大约Hounsfield单位(HU)处理. 下颚和牙齿被用牙科分解器分出[3]. 分会用来估计座舱和中座舱的平面,以保持航头一致. 然后,头部被定位为以外侧内侧中点作为参考,而隐形平面向下倾斜为前侧7-7-Circ}。 为了确定参考舌头的位置,口腔-口腔空气(HU <-500 <-500)被取而代之的是软组织(40 HU).

blocks.zh: 3 实验和结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset and Splits
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和分割

blocks.en:
The dataset comprised 12,340 image pairs from
358 patients, divided into training (283 patients,
8,490 pairs), validation (25 patients, 500 pairs),
and testing (50 patients, 3350 pairs), without patient overlap.

blocks.en:
Three test sets used the same 50 test patients.
The natural-error set (1,000 pairs, M1–M3)
assessed correction under a sampled mixture of
individual and combined errors. The balanced-error
set (1,350 pairs, M1–M3) included all nine error
categories at three severity levels per patient,
with one error per image, enabling comparisons
across error types and severity. The M4 set (1,000 pairs) used the same error sampling as the natural-error set. It tested correction on a simulated imaging geometry that was not used
for training or validation.

measure (SSIM) measured similarity in local brightness,
contrast, and structure.

对比和结构

at different widths, using normalized cross-correlation
to identify the best match.

blocks.en: 3.4 Results
blocks.zh: 3.4 结果

blocks.en:
All five approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors across
the three test sets (Table 2 ). U-Net and the two error-aware
approaches outperformed pix2pix and conditional diffusion across all four metrics.
Improvements were retained on M4, a simulated geometry excluded from training, where
the mixture achieved the best results.

方法的性能超过像素2pix,并在所有四个度量中有条件地传播.
保留了对M4的改进,该模拟几何学被排除在培训之外。
混合物取得了最佳效果。

blocks.en:

errors (Table 3 ).

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4. 结论和讨论

blocks.en:
This study developed a physics-based simulator to
generate paired panoramic images and compare AI
approaches for correcting positioning errors.
Experiments showed that these approaches could
reduce positioning-related distortions under
controlled simulated conditions. The findings
support investigating correction of existing images
as a potential alternative to repeating examinations.
Future work should evaluate real panoramic images
and include clinical assessment to determine whether
correction preserves the anatomy needed for diagnosis.
blocks.zh:
本研究开发出一个基于物理的模拟器
生成对齐全景图像并比较 AI
纠正定位错误的方法。
实验表明,这些方法可以
减少与定位有关的扭曲
控制模拟条件。 调查结果
支持调查对现有图像的校正
作为重复考试的一种潜在替代办法。
今后的工作应评价真实的全景图像
并包括临床评估,以确定是否
矫正保留了诊断所需的解剖学.
